messages.subject: reorder dotchart by diff
parts:
Dear list,

I would like to make a dotchart and reorder the dots by difference
between the two years "t2006" and "t2009". I found a solution, but
it's a really hack. So I appreciate any hints
for a better solution!!

library(ggplot2)
set.seed(123)

x1 <- data.frame(id = LETTERS[1:14], time = "t2006",
value=round(runif(14) * 100,0))
x2 <- data.frame(id = LETTERS[1:14], time = "t2009",
value=round(runif(14) * 100,0))
x <- rbind(x1, x2)

# Calculte the Difference between the two years (a really awful hack)
x <- x[order(x$id, x$time),]
ww <- x[x$time == "t2009", "value"] - x[x$time == "t2006", "value"]
x$diff <- unlist(lapply(ww, FUN=function(x) df=c(NA, x)))
x <- x[order(x$diff), ]
xd <- x[!is.na(x$diff), "id"]
x$id <- factor(x$id, levels=xd)

p <- ggplot(x, aes(value, id, color = time)) + geom_point()
p

Thanks for any help!!
Patrick

messages.author: a5be32bcb3d808db
messages.subject: Re: reorder dotchart by diff
parts:
Hi Patrick,
I don't see a better approach in general. The implimentation could be
cleaned up, along the lines of

x.w <- as.data.frame(cast(x, id ~ time))
x.w$dif <- x.w$t2009 - x.w$t2006
x.new <- rename(melt(x.w, measure.vars = c("t2006", "t2009")),
c(variable = "time"))
x.new$id <- reorder(x.new$id, x.new$dif)

HTH,
Ista

One slightly more elegant approach is:

ddply(x, "id", summarise,
diff = value[time == "t2006"] - value[time == "t2009"])
